thread:
alice: noticed a spike of 504s for hosted-api-prod around 12:04 UTC, customers reporting timeouts
ben: seeing the same in SLO dashboards, error rate jumped from 0.2% to 6%
caroline: customer support got an escalation, they hit a 30s gateway timeout repeatedly, asking for repro and mitigation
sara: customer says requests queue up then 504s. no auth/billing errors on their side.
deploy-bot: deploy hook: no recent deploys to inference runtime in the last 2 hours.
mike: checking autoscaler graphs — HPA target pods increased but KEDA ScaledObject metrics show a delay before scale event, looks like backoff kicks in
ben: interesting, HPA tried to add replicas but new pods stuck in Init for ~20-40s, readiness probe delay = warmup. gateway then returned 504 when queue exceeded threshold
alice: logs from provisioner show repeated "scaledobject backoff: cooldown active" messages and "no new scaleup permitted"
caroline: can you paste the exact logs? we need an actionable repro for support ticket
mike: paste logs:
```
2024-08-03T12:03:51Z provisioner INFO ScaledObject: tenant-xyz backoffCooldown=30s, attempts=3
2024-08-03T12:04:05Z runtime WARN pod/model-init slow_init=true, kv-cache-fetch=18s
2024-08-03T12:04:12Z k8s INFO pod prod-infer-7 Initializing model weights (step=3/5)
2024-08-03T12:04:36Z runtime ERROR readiness probe timeout after 25s
2024-08-03T12:04:45Z gateway ERROR request queue length=672, serve_timeout exceeded
```
ben: repro steps so far: flood burst (50 qps) to a cold tenant route; HPA target adds replicas but KEDA cooldown prevents sustained second wave of scale-ups, some pods never become ready fast enough
sara: customer-facing mitigation we can offer now? they want immediate relief
mike: quick mitigation options: 1) route heavy tenants to dedicated capacity if available, 2) lower probe initialDelay/timeout temporarily, 3) reduce KEDA backoff (cooldown) to allow more aggressive scaleups, 4) pre-warm by keeping minReplicas >0 for that tenant
alice: (typo) alice: +1 to pre-warm but needs infra change
caroline: I'm drafting a support reply: explain root cause (scale-up lag + KEDA cooldown) and propose steps. need confirmation on safe probe changes
ben: probe tweak: set readiness timeout 10s -> 20s? currently 25s failing because model init takes 18s. better to increase probe period or adjust successThreshold. Alternatively, set pre-warm minReplicas=1 for high-traffic tenants
mike: also found ScaledObject annotation misconfig: `cooldownPeriod: "30"` but KEDA interprets seconds vs minutes depending on version — leads to longer than expected backoff. patch PR incoming: https://git.internal/r/redwood/provisioner/pull/872
sara: can we coordinate a temporary config rollback to reduce cooldown to 10s for affected cluster? customer is on aws-eu-west-1-prod
ben: I can apply a dynamic patch to ScaledObject for the tenant to lower cooldown and increase minReplicas to 1, will monitor metrics
alice: please add a Canary rule: if 5xx rate drops, roll forward; if latency increases, rollback. use the infra runbook for canary steps
caroline: support reply ready draft: "We traced the 504s to autoscaling backoff + model warmup delays. Immediate mitigation options include (A) route your heavy traffic to dedicated capacity, (B) temporary minReplicas bump, (C) apply probe tuning. We're applying a short cooldown reduction and minReplicas bump now and will monitor. Apologies for the disruption." ok to send?
sara: send now, mention expected 15-30m window and ask for logs if they still see errors
mike: post-patch actions: 1) adjust ScaledObject annotation to explicit seconds for KEDA v2, 2) add a prewarm policy for tenants crossing burst threshold, 3) add telemetry to surface model-init times per pod in console
ben: I've applied the patch to tenant-xyz ScaledObject: cooldown=10, minReplicas=1. rolling update started at 12:11 UTC. monitoring.
alice: monitoring shows queue length falling and 504s decreasing at 12:17 UTC :thumbsup:
caroline: support notified customer and opened follow-up ticket for permanent fix and runbook updates
sara: marking escalation resolved for now but flagged as high priority to prevent recurrence
mike: will follow up with a postmortem draft including repro steps and the ScaledObject misinterpretation detail
ben: thanks all — keep this thread updated if anything flares back up
